skill.name: github-release-assistant
skill.description: Generates English and Chinese GitHub README files from repository metadata, optional release configuration, and templates, then guides review and release commit steps.
skill.summary: Generate bilingual GitHub release README files and guide release prep.

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline file names, CJK text detection, and README badge links. The real concerns are the Quick Start command in SKILL.md that executes a Python generator with overwrite enabled and uses an author-specific hidden .codex path. No evidence found of prompt injection or data exfiltration intent.

remediation.suggestion: Replace the author-specific /Users path with a relative skill path or documented launcher that works across installations.

remediation.issue: Overwrite mode is shown in the Quick Start command
remediation.suggestion: Default to a non-overwrite preview or require explicit user confirmation before replacing README files.

remediation.issue: Release workflow can include git push
remediation.suggestion: Keep the confirmation requirement and show git status and diff before any staging, commit, or push action.

content.value_statement: Release notes and README updates can take time before each GitHub release. This skill generates bilingual release documentation and guides review, commit, and push steps.
actual_capabilities: Generates README.md and README.zh.md from repository metadata and optional release_assistant.json.
Reads common project files such as README.md, config.json, PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md, docs, and requirements files.
Builds bilingual sections for overview, contents, capabilities, components, quick start, configuration, license, and credits.
Adds Shields.io and Python version badges when license and version data are available.
Supports English, Chinese, or both languages through script arguments.
Guides git status, diff, commit, and push workflow with user confirmation.
limitations: The generator is template based and may need human editing for nuanced release messaging.
It overwrites README files when the overwrite option is used.
It depends on local repository files and cannot infer missing product strategy.
The documented command contains an author-specific absolute path that may not work on other machines.

use_cases.title: Prepare a bilingual release README
use_cases.description: Generate English and Chinese README files from repository facts before publishing a GitHub release.

use_cases.title: Refresh documentation before tagging
use_cases.description: Update project overview, quick start, capabilities, and license sections before creating a release tag.

use_cases.title: Standardize bilingual project docs
use_cases.description: Use shared templates and style cues to keep release documentation consistent across repositories.

prompt_templates.title: Create bilingual READMEs
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for generated release documentation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate English and Chinese README files for this repository. Use existing project files and ask me for any missing release details.

prompt_templates.title: Use a release config
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my release_assistant.json file to generate both README files. Preserve factual project details and flag missing fields before writing.

prompt_templates.title: Review generated documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the generated README.md and README.zh.md files. Summarize important changes, missing facts, and any sections that need manual edits.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a confirmed release commit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced release workflow with git review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate the bilingual README files, show the diff, propose a concise commit message, and wait for my approval before any git commit or push.

output_examples.input: A maintainer asks for English and Chinese README files for a Python project.
output_examples.output: The assistant creates README.md and README.zh.md with overview, contents, quick start, configuration, license, and credits sections.

output_examples.input: A contributor asks to review documentation before a GitHub release.
output_examples.output: The assistant summarizes changed sections, identifies missing facts, and asks before any commit action.

output_examples.input: A documentation lead provides partial project metadata for a bilingual release.
output_examples.output: The assistant uses available repository files, requests missing details, and produces consistent English and Chinese documentation.

best_practices: Review generated README files before enabling overwrite or publishing changes.
Provide project names, taglines, feature lists, license, and Python version in the config file.
Confirm git staging, commit, and push actions only after reviewing the diff.
anti_patterns: Do not run the overwrite option without checking existing README content.
Do not publish generated release docs without verifying facts and links.
Do not rely on the hardcoded absolute path from the current Quick Start.

faq.question: Does this skill create both English and Chinese documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate README.md, README.zh.md, or both files from repository metadata and templates.

faq.question: Does it need a configuration file?
faq.answer: No. A release_assistant.json file is optional, but it improves accuracy when project details are missing.

faq.question: Will it overwrite existing README files?
faq.answer: Yes, when the overwrite option is used. Review existing documentation before running that mode.

faq.question: Can it commit and push changes?
faq.answer: It can guide the workflow, but the instructions require user confirmation before staging, committing, or pushing.

faq.question: Does it contact GitHub or external APIs?
faq.answer: No evidence found for runtime API calls. It only creates README content that may include external badge links.

faq.question: What should authors fix before publishing this skill?
faq.answer: Replace the hardcoded hidden local path and require clear confirmation before overwrite operations.
